howItWorks.step4Body: Akira ikarita yawe y'ubwishingizi ya digitale kandi usabe igihe cyose uhereye mu gitabo cyawe.

testimonials.quote1: Niyandikishije mu minota icumi kuri telefoni yanjye. Amasezerano ari mu Kinyarwanda gusa — none ndumva neza icyo nishyura.
testimonials.quote2: Igihe papa yanjye yakeneye ubuvuzi, natanze icyifuzo mu app kandi nakurikiranye buri munsi. Nta murongo muremure ku biro.
testimonials.quote3: Nk'umukozi wo mu murima, mfasha imiryango kwiyandikisha mu minota. Kwishyura ukoresheje Mobile Money bituma umusanzu uba uciriritse kuri bose.

licensedPartners.body: Ibicuruzwa byemezwa n'abafatanyabikorwa b'ubwishingizi bemewe mu Rwanda, hamwe n'amasezerano asobanutse ushobora gusoma mbere yo kwiyandikisha.

securePayments.title: Kwishyura byizewe
securePayments.body: Umusanzu ukusanywa binyuze mu nzira z'izi Mobile Money. Igitabo cyawe cy'ubwishingizi n'amakode ya QR yo kwemeza akora hatagaragazwa amakuru yihariye y'umuntu.

trust.verifyPolicy: Emeza ubwishingizi ukoresheje kode ya QR ku ikarita yawe y'ubwishingizi ya digitale.

faq.title: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa
faq.subtitle: Ibisubizo byihuse ku bwishingizi buke kuri Ingoboka.
faq.a1: Ubwishingizi buke butanga ubwishingizi buciriritse, busobanutse bufite umusanzu muto n'inyungu zisobanutse — bwateguwe ku bantu bafite ubwishingizi busanzwe. Ingoboka izana ibi bicuruzwa kuri telefoni yawe.
faq.a2: Nyuma yo guhitamo gahunda, wishyura umusanzu w'ukwezi ukoresheje MTN MoMo cyangwa Airtel Money mu buryo butaziguye. Nta konti ya banki ukeneye.
faq.a3: Fungura ubwishingizi bwawe mu app, kanda Gusaba gishya, sobanura ibyabaye, kandi shyiraho inyandiko zisabwa. Urashobora gukurikirana imiterere yo gusuzuma uhereye ku kibaho cyawe.
faq.a4: Yego. Dukurikiza amategeko yo kurinda amakuru mu Rwanda, dukoresha imiyoboro yizewe, kandi dukusanya gusa ibyo dukeneye mu gutanga serivisi z'ubwishingizi. Uha uburenganzira mu buryo butaziguye igihe wiyandikisha.
faq.a5: Abatuye mu Rwanda bafite imyaka 18 n'irindi bashobora kwiyandikisha. Ibicuruzwa bimwe byemera kongeramo abagize umuryango nka bana cyangwa abashakanye. Abakozi nabo bashobora gufasha abakiriya kwiyandikisha mu murima.
faq.a6: Yego. Gahunda nyinshi zemerera kongeramo abagize umuryango nka bana n'abashakanye. Ubuyobozi bw'abagize umuryango bukorerwa ku kibaho cyawe cy'umunyagihugu nyuma yo kwiyandikisha.
faq.a7: Turakumenyesha mbere y'itariki yo kwishyura. Niba wishyuye utishyuye, ubwishingizi bwawe bushobora kwinjira mu gihe cy'ubuntu. Reba amasezerano y'ubwishingizi bwawe cyangwa twandikire ubufasha.
faq.a8: Buri ikarita y'ubwishingizi ya digitale ifite kode ya QR. Uwo ari we wese arashobora kuyisikana kugira ngo yemeze ko ubwishingizi burimo akora hatagaragazwa amakuru y'umuntu.

vision.body: U Rwanda aho buri muryango ufite ubwishingizi burumvikana, bwishyurwa ukoresheje Mobile Money kandi bubahirizwa kuri telefoni.

rwanda.body: Ingoboka yateguwe hashingiwe ku buzima bw'u Rwanda — kwishyura ukoresheje Mobile Money, ubufasha mu Kinyarwanda, abafatanyabikorwa b'ubwishingizi bemewe, n'ibicuruzwa byiciriritse ku bajyejwe n'ubuzima bwa buri munsi.

office.title: Ibiro
office.note: Ku bufasha bwihuse ku bwishingizi cyangwa ibyifuzo, injira kuri konti yawe cyangwa utwandikire kuri imeyili.

intro.title: Intangiriro
intro.p1: Ingoboka ("twe", "twebwe") ikora urubuga rwa digitale rw'ubwishingizi buke mu Rwanda. Iyi Politiki y'ubuzima bwite isobanura uko dukusanya, dukoresha, tubika, kandi turinda amakuru yawe y'umuntu igihe ukoresha urubuga rwacu n'ibikoresho bya telefoni.
intro.p2: Ukoresheje Ingoboka, wemera imikorere isobanurwa muri iyi politiki. Turagutera inkunga gusoma neza kandi utwandikire niba ufite ibibazo.

data.title: Amakuru dukusanya
data.p1: Dukusanya amakuru utanga igihe wiyandikisha no gukoresha serivisi zacu, harimo amazina yawe, numero ya telefoni, imeyili, indangamuntu (aho bisabwa ku bwishingizi), amakuru y'abagize umuryango, amakuru y'ubwishingizi, inyandiko z'ibyifuzo, n'amakuru yo kwishyura binyuze muri Mobile Money.
data.p2: Dukusanya kandi amakuru ya tekiniki nka ubwoko bwa mudasobwa, mushakisha, aderesi ya IP, n'inyandiko z'imikoreshereze kugira ngo urubuga rube rwizewe kandi rinoze.

law.title: Shingiro ry'amategeko — Itegeko 058/2021
law.p1: Dukoresha amakuru y'umuntu mu buryo buhuje n'itegeko ry'u Rwanda N° 058/2021 rishya ku kurinda amakuru y'umuntu n'ubuzima bwite. Harimo kubona uburenganzira bwawe aho bisabwa, gukoresha amakuru gusa ku ntego zisobanuwe, no kubaha uburenganzira bwawe nk'uwufite amakuru.
law.p2: Amakuru ajyanye n'ubwishingizi ashobora gukorwaho kugira ngo hashyirwe mu bikorwa amasezerano n'abafatanyabikorwa b'ubwishingizi bemewe bemera ibicuruzwa dutanga ku rubuga.

rights.title: Uburenganzira bwawe
rights.p1: Mu mategeko akurikizwa, ufite uburenganzira bwo kugera ku makuru yawe, kuyakosora cyangwa gukuraho, gukuramo uburenganzira, kwivanga ku bikorwa bimwe, no gusaba koherezwa amakuru aho bishoboka mu buryo bwa tekiniki.
rights.p2: Kugira ngo ukoreshe izi nshingano, twandikire kuri hello@ingoboka.rw. Tuzasubiza mu gihe cyagenwe n'amategeko.

security.title: Umutekano
security.p1: Dukoresha ubushobozi bwo gushyiraho ibanga, imigenzo yo kugera ku makuru, n'uburyo bwizewe bwo kurinda amakuru yawe. Nubwo nta sisitemu itagira ibyago, dukomeza gusuzuma imikorere yacu y'umutekano.

contact.title: Twandikire
contact.p1: Ku bibazo bijyanye n'ubuzima bwite, twandikire kuri hello@ingoboka.rw cyangwa uandikire Ingoboka, Kigali, u Rwanda.

acceptance.title: Kwemera amasezerano
acceptance.p1: Ukoresheje urubuga rwa Ingoboka, wemera aya Masezerano ya Serivisi na Politiki yacu y'ubuzima bwite. Niba utabyemera, nyamuneka ntukoreshe serivisi zacu.

services.title: Serivisi zacu
services.p1: Ingoboka itanga urubuga rwa digitale rwo gushakisha, kwiyandikisha, no gucunga ibicuruzwa by'ubwishingizi buke byemezwa n'abafatanyabikorwa b'ubwishingizi bemewe mu Rwanda.
services.p2: Turi urubuga rwa tekinoloji — amasezerano y'ubwishingizi ari hagati yawe n'uwatanga ubwishingizi. Amasezerano y'ubwishingizi, ibishingiwe, ibitari mu bwishingizi, n'ibyemezo by'ibyifuzo bigengwa n'inyandiko z'ubwishingizi z'uwatanga ubwishingizi.

accounts.title: Konti
accounts.p1: Ugombwa gutanga amakuru y'ukuri igihe wiyandikisha. Ufite inshingano zo kurinda amakuru yawe yo kwinjira no gukora byose kuri konti yawe.
accounts.p2: Ugombwa kuba ufite nibura imyaka 18 kandi utuye mu Rwanda kugira ngo wiyandikishe, keretse kwiyandikisha nk'umuryango w'undi munyamuryango.

payments.title: Kwishyura
payments.p1: Umusanzu wishyurwa binyuze mu nzira za Mobile Money zemewe. Kutishyura bishobora gutuma ubwishingizi buhagarara ukurikije amasezerano y'ubwishingizi bwawe. Amafaranga yose n'ibiciro byerekanwa mbere yo kwemeza kwiyandikisha.

claims.title: Ibyifuzo
claims.p1: Ibyifuzo byoherejwe binyuze muri Ingoboka byoherezwa ku watanga ubwishingizi ukwiye kugira ngo bisuzumwe. Tugufasha gukurikirana imiterere ariko ntitufata ibyemezo by'ubwishingizi cyangwa by'ibyifuzo.

liability.title: Imipaka y'inshingano
liability.p1: Ingoboka itangwa "nk'uko iri" mu rugero rwemewe n'amategeko. Ntabwo dushinzwe ibyemezo by'uwatanga ubwishingizi, guhagarara kwa serivisi biturutse ku bintu tutabasha kugenzura, cyangwa igihombo gituruka ku makuru atari yo watanze.

changes.title: Impinduka
changes.p1: Dushobora guhindura aya masezerano rimwe na rimwe. Gukomeza gukoresha nyuma yo gushyiraho impinduka bivuze ko wabyemera. Impinduka zikomeye zizamenyeshwa binyuze ku rubuga cyangwa kuri imeyili.
